companyDescription: Enterprise CRM / AI agents · Agentforce + Data Cloud are the AI monetization story; the stock is the market's proxy for 'AI disrupts seat-based SaaS' fear · Q3 FY27 results Dec 2, 2026 AMC
priceNote: Self-fetched (Yahoo chart API, Nov 18, 2026 intraday): $189.45 (-2.6%), after -9.4% on Nov 17 to $194.52 — its worst day since May 2024 — in a software rout ahead of the Anthropic IPO (ServiceNow -6.5%, Intuit ~-7%). Closed $217.84 on Nov 13. 1-year closing range $150.12–$266.23.
summary: A sentiment-driven washout into a dated print. CRM fell ~13% in two sessions (Nov 17–18) on AI-disruption fears and Anthropic IPO supply, with no company news. Q3 FY27 results are confirmed for Dec 2 after the close, against company guidance of $11.42–11.50B revenue. Consensus ~$245 (52 analysts) implies +29%, but targets are falling (Morgan Stanley $187 Equal Weight, BofA $160 Underperform), so the gate clears on a stale-skewed average. Mega-cap self-check: a +20% move needs a re-rating, not a beat — the realistic path is gap-filling the Nov 17 drop on an Agentforce/RPO beat. Core at-catalyst median -6.5% (n=157) → Entry 2 preferred. Base +12% is a ~2-week horizon, near the 14d P75 (+10.8%). แนะนำ 5–8% ของ capital เท่านั้น.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY2027 earnings — Agentforce / Data Cloud + Q4 guide
catalysts.description: Confirmed for Wednesday Dec 2, 2026 after the close, webcast 5:00 p.m. ET (company IR, Nov 10). Guide: Q3 revenue $11.42–11.50B. The print needs to show AI (Agentforce) revenue and cRPO holding up to answer the 'seat compression' bear case.

catalysts.name: Anthropic IPO — supply + sentiment overhang
catalysts.description: The Nov 17 software selloff was tied to the pending Anthropic IPO (AI-native competition narrative + new supply for AI allocations). The IPO's pricing and reception shape software sentiment into the print. No confirmed pricing date found.

risks: Narrative risk dominates: the selloff was about AI-native disruption of seat-based software, not numbers. A clean beat may not reverse it if Q4 guidance or cRPO is merely in line.
Analyst targets are falling: Morgan Stanley downgraded to Equal Weight ($187), BofA reinstated Underperform ($160), Northland downgraded to Market Perform ($264). The $245 average is stale-skewed.
Mega-cap physics: +20% within weeks on a ~$180B company requires a re-rating; the core lane's 14d P75 max gain is only +10.8%.
Further supply/sentiment pressure from the Anthropic IPO and AI capex debates could push CRM toward the $150 1-year low regardless of results.
Macro is WAIT (30/100): the S&P sits on its 200-day at a 5-month low with VIX ~23–26.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) lands a week before the print.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Large-cap software is cash-generative, so rates matter less than the AI-disruption narrative. Higher long yields still compress the multiple at the margin.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the stock's driver is sector narrative, but macro is WAIT (30/100). Let PCE (Nov 25) pass before adding; size the position to survive a gap either way on Dec 2.

entryStrategy.verdict: BUY (Speculative) — a sentiment washout into a confirmed Dec 2 print, +29% to consensus. The measured core at-catalyst median is -6.5% with 65% of picks underwater at their event, so report price is not the default entry: Entry 2 ($178–185) is preferred. Mega-cap: expect a gap-fill (TP1), not +30%, inside 14 days.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Software names usually drift into prints. This setup is a pre-print washout instead: -13% in two sessions with no company news, so expectations are reset low.

postWin.note: CRM rose ~11% after its Q3 FY25 beat (Dec 4, 2024). A beat from a washed-out base fits the upper half.

postLose.note: CRM fell ~20% on May 30, 2024 after a revenue miss and soft guide — its worst day since 2004 at the time.

spotSizing.reason: 6% (spot). earnings_beat sits at +4.2pp medianExcess vs +4.1pp overall (n=89) — neutral, neither laggard nor leader. Mega-cap with a narrative headwind and a WAIT macro tape: mid sizing, scaled in.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Q4 guide or cRPO disappoints and the stock closes below the pre-print low, exit — May 2024 shows how far a guide miss can run.

catalysts.name: IPO ของ Anthropic — แรงกดด้านอุปทาน + sentiment
catalysts.description: การเทขายซอฟต์แวร์ 17 พ.ย. เชื่อมโยงกับ IPO ของ Anthropic ที่ใกล้เข้ามา (เรื่องเล่าคู่แข่ง AI-native + อุปทานใหม่สำหรับเงินลงทุนธีม AI) ราคาและการตอบรับของ IPO จะกำหนด sentiment ของซอฟต์แวร์ก่อนงบ ยังไม่พบวันกำหนดราคา

risks: ความเสี่ยงเรื่องเล่าเป็นหลัก: การเทขายเป็นเรื่อง AI-native disrupt ซอฟต์แวร์แบบคิดตาม seat ไม่ใช่ตัวเลข งบดีอาจไม่พลิกสถานการณ์ถ้า guide Q4 หรือ cRPO แค่ตามคาด
เป้านักวิเคราะห์กำลังลด: Morgan Stanley ลดเป็น Equal Weight ($187), BofA กลับมาที่ Underperform ($160), Northland ลดเป็น Market Perform ($264) ค่าเฉลี่ย $245 เอียงไปทางเป้าเก่า

แรงกดด้านอุปทาน/sentiment เพิ่มเติมจาก IPO ของ Anthropic และประเด็น AI capex อาจกด CRM ไปหา low 1 ปี $150 ไม่ว่างบจะออกมาอย่างไร
